markets.question: Xi Jinping out before 2027?
markets.description:
This market will resolve to "Yes" if China's General Secretary of the Communist Party, Xi Jinping, is removed from power for any length of time between July 3, 2025, and December 31, 2026, 11:59 PM ET. Otherwise, this market will resolve to "No".

CCP General Secretary Xi Jinping will be considered removed from power if he announces his resignation from his role as General Secretary, or is otherwise dismissed, detained, disqualified, or otherwise loses his position or is prevented from fulfilling his duties as General Secretary within this market's timeframe.

The primary resolution source for this market will be a consensus of credible reporting.

eventMetadata.context_description: The 2028 presidential contest remains highly fluid more than two years out, with trader consensus showing no clear frontrunner and probabilities spread across dozens of potential nominees from both parties. JD Vance leads at 21.6 percent amid ongoing positioning within the current administration, yet Marco Rubio, Gavin Newsom, Jon Ossoff, and Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez each sit in the 9–12 percent range, reflecting broad uncertainty ahead of the 2026 midterms. Outcomes in those congressional and gubernatorial races could elevate or sideline sitting senators, governors, and other figures through shifts in polling averages, fundraising, and party infrastructure. Subsequent developments such as primary endorsements, early battleground-state surveys, or legislative votes on major policy priorities may begin consolidating support and widening gaps in implied probabilities.
